name: Asymmetric Algebraic Bait (Directed Dependency Trap)
description: Replaces the symmetric system of linear equations with an algebraically asymmetric equation ($s_u^{s_v} + s_v = 3$) and directional flavor text ("projection from u into v"). This baits models into building a directed graph and failing to traverse weakly connected components correctly, while mathematically preserving the exact symmetric constraint $s_u \neq s_v$ over the domain $\{1, 2\}$.
